title: Bound the PR5580 κ .0033 budget and ideal isolated-tail edit counts
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This composite adds a historical exact PR5569 price certificate and a
separate current PR5580 analytic transfer/count certificate. For exact
PR5580 head `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`, the optimistic
strict-single-use isolated-tail class needs at least **146 ideal exchanges
per FULL** with the permitted controller law, or **147** with the submitted
18-FULL caller retained, at C=.0033 and C=.0033000005.

The source paid change is `+H2−2H3+H4` per FULL, with targets unchanged.
The current certificate transfers the authenticated PR5569 B/J intervals
through `B5580=B5569−gD`, where `gD=2H3−H2−H4`. At C=.0033:

```
2.95302944896150557847079 < B5580 < 2.95303581796150557847087.
```

The count proof charges the productive rank loss of every isolated tail.
Granted multiset witnesses use94H4+52H5 for146/n17 and94H4+53H5 for147/n18,
with complete paid/target/surplus60604/12079/712 and64206/12814/760.
Their complete raw slack is positive but below one global H1; an added
uncompensated global H1 defeats these particular witnesses. Every query,
whole idle and main bank is charged. Ordinary costs and compiler reserve
remain separate.

This is an exact two-point necessary-budget/count result in an explicitly
optimistic accounting class. It finds no actual146/147 contacts, establishes
no compatible source edits, constructs no17-call caller, certifies no new
funded κ and changes no selected result. Frame/endpoint/native, uniform
precision/tape and complete compiler/outer premises remain open. Balanced
concavity and the PR5554 all-n implication are paper arguments, not a
proof-kernel theorem. There is no larger-C or general P104 ceiling claim.

## Task and overlap

Publication head `c8b49410fb31d107d8c85d160ac5ca737c403231`, tested tree `7e102b38d64ca97c43f0648ac8e275a3918ed111`, directly based on `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Current upstream main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53` and guidance were checked separately at the21:09UTC prepublication checkpoint. Both package byte sets and source history were checked against the exact remote commit;87 files are added.

Task `scalar-to-moment`, priority revision7, changed scope. The original
construction-gain gate is not met. The useful contribution is a current
complete aggregate budget that prevents one attractive isolated contact
from being mistaken for a complete .0033 route.

- `research/p104-successor-price-gate`: immutable37-file historical PR5569
  certificate at head `af9f091ac6f30c6eaacb9c27777bfbe2d0e5ffdf`.
- `research/p104-current-tail-count`: separate current certificate for
  Ali Romman's [PR5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580),
  exact head `6efa248cf456d6101d757e9d09ba29711d18a13a`.

GamingPuzzled's PR5569/5472 supply the predecessor handoff/cost lineage;
zxv's PR5554 supplies the all-controller reduction. PR5585's native work
is distinct from this price/count artifact. PR5579's fixed-anchor owned
holder obstruction is tied to its5561/5569 sources and does not transfer
automatically to5580's changed anchor. Constructive inventories remain
outside this package. A broader A/B/C/D accounting family is under separate
paper assessment, outside isolated tails; no resulting theorem or physical
composition is claimed here. No exhaustive novelty claim is made.

## Validation

Original current qualification: one root-reviewed normal/optimized pair,
0.905806529seconds and63,401,984bytes sampled descendant RSS under the
unchanged150second/512MiB serial guard. All25 classified controls rejected
and every scientific output byte matched, with zero exclusions. Result:
`f0ab2ed10f91a5acd76c1c6753d970c59e51e83c3d0b96fe8a6a3a6c3f80e9de`.

The current wrapper preserves check.py, finite.py, request, inputs, both
results and guard/log byte for byte. It authenticates every package/input
byte, executes only the current finite certificate in an isolated private
child limited to60seconds/512MiB, compares complete original output, then
reauthenticates. It imports no price engine, source constructor or native
module. Both source RESULT serializations and their explicit custody
revision are retained; the historical derived hash was not silently
replaced by the exact author-text hash.

Current-package commands:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-current-tail-count --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_P104_CURRENT_TAIL_COUNT`. The historical package
retains its own registered reproduction command and evidence unchanged;
its science is not rerun as part of this static preparation.

Portable current normal/-O registered replay passed in1.714seconds, sampled88.61MiB, under the unchanged150seconds/512MiB guard. Separate read-only Git-free optimized export with spaces and empty PATH passed in.705seconds, sampled63.70MiB; all51 exported files remained unchanged. Three custody corruptions reject before science in both modes. Metadata and50-file exact committed-byte/history checks passed.

The historical component independently passed its portable registered pair in1.912seconds, sampled73.89MiB, and read-only optimized export in.906seconds, sampled48.84MiB; all38 exported files remained unchanged. Its37 scientific-package files are preserved exactly. Local checks are scoped; hosted CI is pending at submission.

The three portable source/result/raw-serialization corruptions use
`--integrity-only` and must reject before science. Export execution should
use read-only files, empty PATH, an absolute interpreter and complete
before/after file hashes. `VERIFY.inputs=[]` is intentional: all runtime
source bytes are inside each package, so no machine-local path is declared
as a repository input.

## Open next questions

See both packages' NEXT.md, especially
`research/p104-current-tail-count/NEXT.md`. A physical proposal must supply
distinct actual helper/terminal-MOVE IDs, legal source windows/charts,
ownership, compatibility, all changed paid/target/ordinary costs and
compiler reserves. Aggregate ideal counts alone are insufficient. Broader
A/B/C/D economics need a separately defined complete family and review.
Independent human/formal review of the retained analytic implications is
useful; no construction or contact scan is dispatched by this publication.


Current overlap/context: [PR5590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5590), head627160c5e39501b69603c3a1e03bbfdc50a53a86, reports a sharp price floor for fixed scalar contacts and arbitrary frame paths on5580. We have not replayed that proof. It is distinct from this explicitly optimistic inventory class, which grants contacts/attachments and does not assert physical realization. [Discussion5575](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5575) now owns the specified commuting-ADD/order plus intermediate-frame optimization; [Discussion5125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125) owns joint input/output basis splitting. A future constructive task must coordinate with those owners; this publication reserves no contact search.
